name: Ne Krychy
source:
Maya returns after 30 years to the place of mysterious events that took place during her youth.
Will she find answers in the Carpathian forest? Will she understand herself and accept her essence?

Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a winter Ukrainian forest and learn the history of a mysterious place.

[Translated from [url=https://hmarkaua.itch.io/dontscream]itch.io[/url]]
